title: BlobFS
description: BlobFS is a file format where files are blobs that merge and split. Merges of different kinds stay proposals until a person accepts them. The .orb archive stores content-addressed payloads. The code is MIT. The paper text is a separate work; paper/arxiv/SUBMISSION.md recommends CC BY 4.0 for that text, and this software record does not license the paper. This metadata is for a GitHub release that Zenodo has not minted yet.
